purpose: Independent Counter startup source, missing-view availability and blocked-contact caller-order references. This protocol does not close normal-input Counter or M15S4.

source_activation.scope: Actual activation and NI updates; synthetic cache/metadata/scene/notification boundaries.

rules: Only active camera resource availability decides whether Counter begins: camera byte0 selects FP; byte1 selects body.
On success, each available view plays independently. An absent mirror preserves its old slot3 pointer.
Process action2 retains the current BODY slot3 pointer, even when only FP played. It may therefore retain old BlockHit28 or null when body resource is missing.
Full original action-frame/camera dispatch and failed mirror playback are not represented by the current paired Counter storage. Do not infer phase authority from active-cache selection.
availability.scope: Missing resource behavior reference. Current paired Counter storage rejects partial playback.

boundaries.0x5f3c30: Record actor and return chosen proc boolean.
boundaries.0x5f4e10: Record actor and bool argument, return chosen success pointer with ret4.
boundaries.0x5fc2b0: Record actor/target and return chosen disarm boolean with ret4.
boundaries.0x5f4f00: Record actor; return0 with no stack argument cleanup.

blocked_contact_caller.expected: 600528..60056A: nonranged queries the Counter proc; ranged skips it. One5F4E10 invocation receives that bool. A true proc skips immediate disarm/Recoil regardless of playback success. Without Counter, disarm precedes Recoil; nonranged always requests Recoil, ranged only after successful disarm.
blocked_contact_caller.scope: Original caller instructions/argument and branch order; actual mastery RNG, playback, disarm and Recoil effects are supplied boundaries.
